title: No Thoughts Just AI: Biased LLM Hiring Recommendations Alter Human Decision Making and Limit Human Autonomy

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual resume screening task measuring human hiring preferences for candidates with varying racial identifiers (names and affinity groups) under the influence of simulated biased AI recommendations. Additionally, the study uses cosine similarity in Massive Text Embedding (MTE) models to simulate algorithmic resume screening bias, and employs Implicit Association Tests (IATs) alongside explicit belief questionnaires to evaluate human associations between race and occupational status.
